title: Blessed singletons — exhaustive doctrine exception list (AD4)
doctrineRef: AD0 side-effect doctrine (user-confirmed 2026-06-12): no import-time work; effects behind injected, disposable boundaries; mandatory listener disposal; module-scope mutable state only inside managed lifecycles; blessed singletons enumerated here exhaustively — a module-scope singleton or mutable cache NOT on this list is a doctrine violation, not an implicit exception. Census evidence: P2 state-root ad4-core-doctrine-census-2026-06-12.md.

blessed.reason: Process-global write-safety boundary; only unbypassable as a singleton. 53 cross-repo direct imports; two-layer checks rated healthy by the AD findings.
blessed.lifecycle: process; configure() per host start; exclusion verdict frozen per configure (documented staleness policy)

blessed.reason: The disposal manager itself — the boundary other effects dispose through. Idempotent dispose, unref discipline, post-dispose registration diagnostics (CO3 C8).
Winston logger with in-place reconfiguration preserving module-level references; transports are the managed resource.
blessed.lifecycle: process; getInstance(config) reconfigures in place; close() releases transports

blessed.reason: Single parsed-config authority per process; construction-time file reads (no import-time work).

better-sqlite3 single-connection design; raw db and ORM share one handle. Known limitation (t1 probe): no :memory: targeting, global mutation — the recorded removal trigger for the drizzle keep-alive row is a future test-fixture facade, not an AD4 repair.
Registry of the 16 stateless enhancement packs (constant-class instances); built once on first use.
Project-type discoverer catalog; built once on first use.
Host wires the edge repository once at startup; consumers read the handle (constructed injection at the composition root, held as a module handle).
Host-agent bootstrap sessions; managers are keyed by dataRoot and persist session/lease snapshots under .asd/bootstrap-sessions so process restarts can resume by bootstrapSessionRef.
blessed.lifecycle: process plus dataRoot-local durable index; sessions expire by 2h TTL; same-project concurrent bootstrap is refused as bootstrap_in_progress

blessed.reason: tree-sitter native modules and grammars load lazily on first parse; native handles are not safely reloadable in-process.

Cache policy (AD4, closing the F2 'no policy' finding): both maps are bounded by the registered language set (about a dozen entries), live for the process, and rebuild deterministically; the parser cache has a test reset hook.
Per-key memoization bounded by distinct probed paths / one identity value / distinct guard rule patterns; deterministic recomputation.

constantClass.note: NOT singletons under the doctrine — deterministic constant construction with no I/O and no mutation after build: the 16 enhancement pack instances (core/enhancement/*-enhancement.ts), language tables (shared/LanguageProfiles.ts, shared/LanguageService.ts lazy regex), CallSiteExtractor._extractors literal map, ASTChunker set-once wiring probes.

notInThisRepo.ModelRegistry/getModelRegistry: AlembicAgent owns it (zero hits in Core src/); the Agent AD4 leg rules its disposition
notInThisRepo.F2 Alembic-side sites: auth TOKEN_SECRET, SSE sessions, RateLimiter buckets, guard handler review state, DaemonJobRunner fallbacks, HttpServer listeners — all lib/ paths owned by the Alembic AD4 leg
